**From:** {{< meta from-address >}}  
**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

My dear [Miss Holbeche](../persons.html#2078),
I send some stamps from a Miss Murray at Brighton for your poor blind friend, and by the same post your 13 copies of the [Last Heartsease Leaves](../books.html#45), with many thanks for your kindness in disposing of them, I hope they will not prove so small as to be very disappointing
With many thanks

yours sincerely

C M Yonge

[^1]: The letter is evidently addressed to the author of \'Blindness: Its Trials and Blessings\' MP (July 1861) 91-99.
